benchmarks.label: Brent

peak.note: Futures intraday wartime high (Wikipedia chronology). Physical Dated Brent (EIA spot via FRED) peaked at $138.21 on 2026-04-07 and was $114.89 on 2026-09-22.

benchmarks.note: Rose to about $111.50 on 20 Oct (Trading Economics), up roughly 1.8% on the day, as Iran's main oil-loading terminals remained idle for a ninth week under the US blockade and Washington moved to let 'dark fleet' tankers rejoin legitimate trade to ease record freight rates. Week-ago is this site's 13 Oct reading, exactly 7 days earlier.
